BigNumCalculator.add:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds two numeric string values digit by digit using zero-padding and carry propagation, returning the sum as a string." add]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> num1 </REF>: string "First numeric string operand."
        <REF> num2 </REF>: string "Second numeric string operand."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: string "The sum of num1 and num2 represented as a string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute max_length as the maximum of the lengths of num1 and num2. RESULT max_length]
            [COMMAND Reassign num1 to num1.zfill(max_length), adding leading zeros so that its length equals max_length. RESULT num1]
            [COMMAND Reassign num2 to num2.zfill(max_length), adding leading zeros so that its length equals max_length. RESULT num2]
            [COMMAND Initialize carry to integer 0. RESULT carry]
            [COMMAND Initialize result to an empty list. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Within a for loop that runs when max_length is greater than 0, for each i from max_length - 1 down to 0 inclusive with step -1, compute digit_sum = int(num1[i]) + int(num2[i]) + carry. RESULT digit_sum]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, update carry to digit_sum // 10. RESULT carry]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, compute digit as digit_sum % 10. RESULT digit]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, insert str(digit) at position 0 of result. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND After the for loop completes, if carry is greater than 0, insert str(carry) at position 0 of result. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Return the string formed by joining all elements of result as the final return value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BigNumCalculator.subtract:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Subtract two decimal string numbers digit by digit, swapping operands if necessary to ensure a non-negative subtraction, removing leading zeros, and returning the signed decimal string difference." subtract]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> num1 </REF>: str "First decimal number represented as a string."
        <REF> num2 </REF>: str "Second decimal number represented as a string."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str "The signed decimal string difference between num1 and num2, with leading zeros removed except for a single zero result."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check the lengths of num1 and num2: if len(num1) < len(num2), swap num1 and num2 and set negative to True; else if len(num1) > len(num2), set negative to False; else, if num1 < num2, swap num1 and num2 and set negative to True, otherwise set negative to False. RESULT sign_normalization]
            [COMMAND Compute max_length = max(len(num1), len(num2)); left-pad both num1 and num2 with zeros to max_length using zfill; initialize borrow = 0 and result = []. RESULT initialization]
            [COMMAND For i from max_length - 1 down to 0 inclusive, compute digit_diff = int(num1[i]) - int(num2[i]) - borrow; if digit_diff < 0, add 10 to digit_diff and set borrow = 1, otherwise set borrow = 0; then insert str(digit_diff) at index 0 of result. RESULT digit_subtraction_loop]
            [COMMAND While len(result) > 1 and result[0] == '0', remove result[0]. RESULT leading_zero_removal]
            [COMMAND If negative is True, insert '-' at index 0 of result. RESULT sign_application]
            [COMMAND Return ''.join(result). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BigNumCalculator.multiply:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Multiplies two non-negative integers represented as strings using grade-school digit-by-digit multiplication and returns the product string without leading zeros." multiply]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> num1 </REF>: string "First non-negative integer represented as a string."
        <REF> num2 </REF>: string "Second non-negative integer represented as a string."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> product_str </REF>: string "The product of num1 and num2 represented as a string without leading zeros."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set len1 to len(num1) and len2 to len(num2). RESULT len1_len2]
            [COMMAND Initialize result to a list of zeros of length len1 + len2. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND For i from len1 - 1 down to 0 inclusive, iterate over num1 digits from least significant to most significant. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, for j from len2 - 1 down to 0 inclusive, iterate over num2 digits from least significant to most significant. RESULT j]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop over j, compute mul = int(num1[i]) * int(num2[j]). RESULT mul]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop over j, set p1 = i + j and p2 = i + j + 1. RESULT p1_p2]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop over j, compute total = mul + result[p2]. RESULT total]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop over j, update result[p1] by adding total // 10, and set result[p2] to total % 10. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Set start = 0. RESULT start]
            [COMMAND While start < len(result) - 1 and result[start] == 0, increment start by 1 to skip leading zero digits; because the condition uses a short-circuit and, result[start] is not evaluated when start equals len(result) - 1. RESULT start]
            [COMMAND Return the string formed by joining the string representation of each integer in result[start:] as the multiplication result. RESULT product_str]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
